newsitem.title: USA: Eckerd-Penney in stock option deal.
newsitem.headline: Eckerd-Penney in stock option deal.

text.p: Eckerd Corp said Thursday its merger deal with J.C. Penney Co includes an agreement giving the retailer an option to buy 15 percent its common stock at $35 a share.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Eckerd said the option for 10,554,786 common shares may terminate at the effective time of the merger or if the merger deal is terminated under provisions of the merger pact, whichever comes earlier.
The two companies announced their $3.3 billion, cash, stock and debt deal November 3.

Under the agrement, Penney would pay $35 a share in cash for about 35.5 million common shares of Eckerd. In the second stage of the deal, Eckerd stockholders will receive 0.6604 of a Penney share for each Eckerd share held.
Penney will also assume about $760 million of Eckerd's debt.
